verdict.rationale: Deepgram documents one real per-call data control: by default requests join the Model Improvement Program and are retained, but a request sent with `mip_opt_out=true` is not retained. That covers only a binary per-request retention opt-out. Nothing in the pack shows consent capture, disclosure tooling, recording on/off controls or configurable retention periods; InjectAgentMessage could be used to speak a disclosure line, but that is a developer building block and earns no credit. Missing for 10: per-call recording on/off controls, a consent-capture or disclosure workflow, configurable retention durations or deletion policies, compliance documentation for call-recording laws, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can meet call-recording consent and disclosure obligations with per-call recording controls and configurable data retention

citations.quote: Opt out per request with mip_opt_out=true. Opted-out requests are not retained
Requests participate in the Model Improvement Program (MIP) by default, and Deepgram retains them
